Q10288_SecretMission/32780-05.html.text: Aquilani: Your presence is known. No one would lie about working for the temple. I am your family now. What do you need?

default/32780.htm.text: Aquilani: Be cautious of your every thought here. Those who desecrate these sacred grounds never forget.. ever. And when you leave this place, don't ever reflect back on it. Some things are best forgotten. Our brothers and sisters find a comfort here that the rest of the world would deny them. Reme…

Q10288_SecretMission/32780-01.html.text: Aquilani: Halt your approach, wanderer. I wish not to be bothered. Your ignorance will not be forgiven should you trespass.

Q10288_SecretMission/32780-04.html.text: Aquilani: Sorry creature, I am not able to teleport you now. Do not test me on this, it is merely the way of things. Bring Brother Dominic's letter to Greymore in the Monastery. He will be between the 1st and 2nd floor. As I told you before, once you have completed that task, I shall henceforth be …

Q10288_SecretMission/32780-02.html.text: Aquilani: Ah, so you are Brother Dominic's creature. Welcome. But this letter is not for me, it is for Brother Greymore. Are you ready to see him?

Q10288_SecretMission/32780-03.html.text: Aquilani: Good. To find Greymore, you must enter the Monastery of Silence. Greymore studies his craft in a room in-between the 1st and 2nd floor there. Bring him this letter, and then perhaps you will take part in the next step. I will also be able to teleport you directly to his location, once I a…

Q10288_SecretMission/32780-06.html.text: Aquilani: Let me confirm once more. You want to meet Greymore?
